items: 【Foldable Bluetooth Keyboard】The foldable bluetooth keyboard can be folded into pocket size and carried around easily in your backpack.Stable bluetooth connection with max working distance of 10 meters. You can use it anywhere when you need to finish some type work on your phone or tablet.
【Latest Sensitive Touchpad】Portable wireless keyboard has latest sensitive touchpad support multi-touch function(NOTE: iOS 13.4 and below or Android 3.0 and below are not supported!!!)
【Rechargeable Durable Battery】The portable keyboard has built-in rechargeable lithium battery, it has auto-sleep mode to save power, provides 2 months of standby battery life on a single charge.
【Quiet Typing】The folding keyboard has scissor switches low-profile keys design, offers efficiently typing with comfort and quiet.
【Wide Compatibility】Bluetooth keyboard works seamlessly with all iOS/ Android / Windows system bluetooth-enabled phone tablet and laptop.
